يستوئي (form X)
# يَسْتَوْئِي (yastawʔī) /jas.taw.ʔiː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# يَسْتَوْئِيَ (yastawʔiya) /jas.taw.ʔi.ja/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
